title.purpose: Derived object title inside the live card.

body.purpose: Chips, widgets, menus, rows, and Inspector.

shadows.name: omnibar
shadows.purpose: Make the single command object feel tactile on the warm page.

motion.name: card-grow
motion.purpose: Reveal the card as an expansion of the omnibar surface.

breakpoints.name: mobile
breakpoints.purpose: Use full-width omnibar margins and bottom-sheet Inspector.

components.name: Omnibar Shell
components.description: Centered command input that expands into the live card.

components.name: Live Card
components.description: One schema-specific object grown from the omnibar.

components.name: Timer Card
components.description: Raw phrase title, parsed label header, 150px SVG countdown ring, and start/pause/reset controls.

components.name: Editable Chip
components.description: Dashed empty or filled metadata pill with inline editing.

components.name: Command Menu
components.description: Slash menu for all 19 card types.

components.name: Committed Row
components.description: Persisted local object summary below the omnibar.

components.name: Inspector
components.description: Classifier diagnostics plus per-provider shopping expansion comparison for JEV, Foundry, and optional Foundry web search with source links.

narrative.overview: A warm centered omnibar progressively grows into one live card with parsed chips, deterministic widgets, local commit rows, slash locking, and an optional Inspector.
keyCharacteristics: Warm off-white page and one tactile white command surface.
Blue is reserved for focus and classifier bars.
Dashed chips mean missing metadata; filled chips mean typed or computed evidence.
No placeholder chip values are invented.

rules.name: One Live Object
rules.body: The command surface may show only one active card at a time.

rules.name: Evidence Before UI
rules.body: No card appears until accepted classifier evidence, deterministic parser evidence, or a user lock exists.

rules.name: Typed Truth
rules.body: Chip values come only from the phrase, manual edits, deterministic results, or expansion output.

dos: Show per-provider expansion pending, error, latency, source, and item diagnostics in Inspector.
donts: Do not use gradient text or generic AI purple.
Do not show static placeholder values.
Do not call expansion for plain grocery lists.
Do not turn the surface into chat.
